title: 丑奴儿·书博山道中壁
titlePy: Chǒu Nú Ér · Shū Bó Shān Dào Zhōng Bì
titleEn: To the Tune “Ugly Servant”: Written on a Wall on the Road to Mount Bo
author: 辛弃疾
intro: Young, he climbed towers to write sad poems about a sorrow he had never felt. Old, he knows sorrow through and through — and all he says is “What a nice cool autumn.” Eight short lines about growing up.
analysis: 这首词用“少年”和“而今”作对比。上阕写年轻时：根本不知道什么是真正的愁，却喜欢登上高楼，为了写新词，硬说自己很愁——“强说愁”就是没有愁也装出愁的样子。下阕写现在：经历了国家分裂、理想落空、被朝廷冷落，什么样的愁都尝尽了，真想说的时候反而说不出口，最后只淡淡说一句“天凉了，好一个秋天啊”。愁到深处，反而不说。两阕都用了重复：“爱上层楼，爱上层楼”“欲说还休，欲说还休”，前一个写少年的轻快，后一个写中年的欲言又止，一样的句式，完全不同的心情。这首词语言像口语，却说出了很多人都有的人生体会，所以“为赋新词强说愁”“欲说还休”到今天还常被引用。
analysisEn: The whole lyric is built on one contrast: “when I was young” versus “now”. In the first half the young poet has no idea what real sorrow is, yet he loves climbing tall towers — the classic place for a sad poem — and to write a new lyric he forces himself to sound sorrowful. 强说愁 means exactly that: putting on a sadness you don’t have. In the second half he has tasted every kind of sorrow: a divided country, a dream of winning back the north that never came true, years pushed aside by the court. Now, when he really has something to say, he can’t bring himself to say it, and all that comes out is “The weather’s turned cool — such a fine autumn.” The deepest sorrow hides behind small talk. Each half repeats a line: “I loved to climb the tower, loved to climb the tower” sounds light and eager; “I want to speak, then stop; I want to speak, then stop” sounds hesitant and heavy. Same pattern, opposite feelings. The language is close to everyday speech, and the insight is universal, so phrases like 为赋新词强说愁 and 欲说还休 are still quoted today.
background: Xin Qiji (1140–1207) spent about ten years in forced retirement near Shangrao, Jiangxi, after 1181. Mount Bo was nearby, and he often passed through it; he is said to have written this on the wall of a house along that road.
pronunciation: 少年 shào nián；强说愁 qiǎng（勉强，不读 qiáng）；为赋 wèi fù；层楼 céng lóu。“欲说还休”的“还”：本页按 huán 注音（不少读本作 huán），也有很多人读 hái，请按所用教材定。机器朗读“强”“还”已在“朗读用字”列替换同音字。
version: 采用统编初中语文教材（课外古诗词诵读）文本。词牌“丑奴儿”又名“采桑子”。全词上下两阕，共八句。

lines.py: shào nián bù shí chóu zī wèi
lines.lit: When young, I did not know the taste of sorrow;
lines.en: When I was young, I didn’t know what sorrow tasted like.

lines.lit: I loved to climb the storied tower.
lines.en: I loved to climb the tower,

lines.lit: I loved to climb the storied tower,

lines.py: wèi fù xīn cí qiǎng shuō chóu
lines.lit: and, to write a new lyric, forced myself to speak of sorrow.
lines.en: and, for a new poem, pretended to be sad.

lines.py: ér jīn shí jìn chóu zī wèi
lines.lit: Now I know every taste of sorrow;
lines.en: Now I know sorrow in every flavour.

lines.lit: I want to speak, and then stop.
lines.en: I want to speak — and stop.

lines.lit: I want to speak, and then stop,
lines.en: I want to speak — and stop,

lines.py: què dào tiān liáng hǎo gè qiū
lines.lit: but instead I say: the weather’s cool — what a fine autumn.
lines.en: and only say, “It’s turned cool. Such a fine autumn.”

words.note: 古代“少年”指年轻人，范围比今天的“少年”（十几岁）宽。
识：知道、懂得。现代汉语说“不懂”“不知道”，“认识”的“识”。
现代汉语仍说，如“心里不是滋味”。

words.en: in order to write a new lyric
to force oneself to talk of sorrow
words.note: 强：勉强。现代汉语“勉强”“强人所难”的“强”。
书面语，现代汉语说“现在”“如今”。

words.en: to want to speak but stop
words.note: 欲：想要；休：停止、算了。今天仍常引用这句。
道：说。今天“能说会道”的“道”。
“好个……”是口语感叹，今天也说“好一个……”。

imagery.name: 楼
imagery.zh: 少年登楼是为了“作诗”，登高望远本来是抒发愁情的地方，他却只是在模仿。
imagery.en: Climbing a tower was the classic setting for a sad poem — the young man climbs it just to strike the pose.

imagery.name: 秋风
imagery.zh: “天凉好个秋”看似随口夸天气，其实把说不出的深愁藏在里面。
imagery.en: “Such a fine autumn” sounds like small talk, but it hides a sorrow too deep to say.
